title: Review
description: An AI or human review of a Submission against a Rubric. All reasoning is visible to the user — no secret scores.

reviewer_type.description: AI = first pass; human = verification for top submissions or appeals.

reviewer_id.description: Model name (e.g. 'claude-sonnet-4-6') for AI; user UUID for humans.

scores.description: One score object per rubric dimension. Mirrors rubric.dimensions.

rationale.description: Plain-English explanation shown to the user. Required — transparency is non-negotiable.

evidence_quotes.description: Exact quotes from the submission that informed this score.

overall_score.description: Weighted sum of dimension scores, normalized to 0-100.

confidence.description: Reviewer confidence in overall_score. Low confidence triggers human review queue.

strengths.description: Specific things the user did well.

next_steps.description: Recommended learning resources or next tasks.

credential_eligible.description: True if overall_score >= pass_threshold defined in the rubric.

human_review_requested.description: Set to true automatically when confidence < 0.7 or score near pass threshold.

appeal_reason.description: User-provided reason if they appealed this review.

model_version.description: Exact model ID used for AI review. Preserved for calibration audits.

prompt_hash.description: SHA-256 of the grading prompt. Lets us detect when prompt changes affect scores.
